errors.evidence: The pie chart contains six segments, not seven.
The blue slice represents "До 20 услуги" and has a value of 32.6%. The description provides an incorrect category label ("до 50 услуги") and assigns the value from the purple slice (28.3%).
The orange slice, which is 13%, corresponds to the category "51 - 80 услуги". The description provides an incorrect, consolidated category label "21-80 услуги".

This is a complete misrepresentation. The green slice corresponds to "81-100 услуги" and has no percentage label. The value 15.2% belongs to the red slice ("21 - 50 услуги"). The category "51-80 услуги" is the orange slice.
This is entirely incorrect. The category "81-100 услуги" is represented by the green slice. The color yellow ("жълто") does not exist in the chart. The value 32.6% belongs to the blue slice.
The purple slice, corresponding to "над 100 услуги", has a value of 28.3%, not 36%.
The slice for "Не се предоставят" is teal, not pink ("розово"). Furthermore, this slice does not have a percentage label in the chart; the value "10%" is hallucinated.
